scope: A75 background: attachment cards, path reference vs copy, hover remove, failed/retry, queue with own attachments, draft across tasks, home first message, copy cleanup (remove, cancel, 24h sweep, archived kept, project delete); isolated real packaged App, real Claude and Codex, local synthetic models, non-relaying SMTP, UI plugin install with a recorded native-picker substitute

checks.label: the project file becomes a path reference (no copy)
the outside file is copied as an attachment and marked as a copy
the image shows as a thumbnail card
removing a card deletes its exclusive copy
the agent receives the project path and the copy path, not the outside original path
after sending, the composer no longer holds those attachments
a failed attachment cannot be sent; text and card stay
after retry the attachment is ready and the message sends
the queued input keeps its attachment and the composer is cleared
canceling the queued input removes its exclusive copy
the queued input is sent later with its own attachment
a draft attachment stays with its task across task switches
on the home page a failed attachment blocks both 启动任务 and ⌘Enter without clearing
the home attachment goes with the new task first message
after 24 h the unreferenced copy is swept, referenced (draft, queued/sent, archived task) copies stay
